ADR 0002: Single-team deployment scope ​

Status ​

Accepted for the current release line.

Decision ​

AegisScan remains a single-team deployment with one flat Admin/Operator/Viewer role matrix. Repository-group and namespace-scoped authorization are explicit non-goals until a multi-team business requirement is approved.

Teams requiring isolation should deploy separate AegisScan instances and separate database/cache resources.
